pilot.name: Cover Letter buyer diagnostic pilot
pilot.day5ReminderRule: Only verified nonresponders who remain unsuppressed are eligible; Revenue owns any send decision and execution.

baselineEvidence: Revenue result RES-1787269803016-98161 records five newly sent messages and one suppression from six reviewed buyers.
Independent Gmail Sent search found exactly five messages with the exact pilot subject in the launch window; each carried the SENT label.
A bounded Gmail search for non-Sent messages with the exact pilot subject returned zero as of verifiedAt.
SENT status proves submission to Gmail Sent, not recipient inbox placement; delivery-failure count remains an observed-bounce measure.

explicitDeliveryFailureRate.numerator: Unique pilot recipients with an explicit Gmail bounce or delivery-failure notification
explicitDeliveryFailureRate.limitation: No failure notification observed is not proof of inbox placement.

humanReplyRate.numerator: Unique pilot recipients with any verified human reply

substantiveDiagnosticReplyRate.numerator: Unique recipients whose reply identifies a usable job-search breakdown
substantiveDiagnosticReplyRate.decisionThreshold: At least 2 substantive replies by Day 7; threshold is directional because n=5.

qualifiedSegmentRate.numerator: Unique substantive repliers assigned exactly one approved diagnostic segment

routedOfferClickRate.numerator: Unique routed recipients with a verified tagged-link click
routedOfferClickRate.denominator: Unique recipients manually sent one approved routed offer

routedPurchaseRate.numerator: Unique routed recipients with transaction-proven purchase during the pilot window
routedPurchaseRate.denominator: Unique recipients manually sent one approved routed offer

attributedRevenueUsd.definition: Gross USD from transaction-proven purchases matched to an approved buyer-level route during the pilot window; refunds reported separately

complaintRate.numerator: Unique recipients making a verified complaint

unsubscribeRate.numerator: Unique recipients with a verified unsubscribe or suppression request after pilot contact

day5ReminderEligibility.numerator: Initial recipients with no human reply, no delivery failure, no complaint, no unsubscribe, and no new suppression at the Day-5 checkpoint

checkpoints.name: Day-5 reminder eligibility check
checkpoints.actionBoundary: Analytics measures eligibility only; Revenue owns any authorized reminder.

limitations: The cohort has five recipients, so percentages are descriptive and highly sensitive to one response.
Gmail SENT status does not prove inbox placement or reading.
Clicks, purchases, and revenue are attributable only with buyer-level tagged-link and transaction proof; rolling-window Stan totals are insufficient.
No causation claim is supported without a control group.
No customer contact was performed by Analytics.
